newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 2.89 pct down on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 2.89 pct down on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks had sagged 2.89 percent by Monday's close as blue chips tumbled on selling by speculators. Dealers said the Karachi 100-share index would take a further beating in the next few days.

"The prices of all heavyweight shares dropped on speculative selling, but there was some support at around 1,860 points," dealer Abid Raza said. "Telecom utility PTCL will slip further as it is still over-valued and over-bought."
The index fell 55.38 points, to end at 1,863.93. Losers led gainers 187 to 44. PTCL fell 1.95 rupees to 38.85 and ICI Pakistan 1.35 to 25.30. -- Amir Zia (9221) 5685192; Fax 5673428
